AHSOKA TANO (LEGENDS) — RESEARCH EXTRACTION

Source URL requested: https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Ahsoka_Tano/Legends
Final URL reached: https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Ahsoka_Tano/Legends
Continuity label: LEGENDS. The page is categorized under “Legends articles” and is not a canon-only page.
Scope note: This is an extraction of what the article states. Bracketed numbers are the article's own citation markers; they are not added claims.

SECTION: Powers and abilities — Lightsaber training (article-stated abilities and scaling)

- The article says Ahsoka studied Shii-Cho, specialized in fast/aggressive Form IV (Ataru) and the Shien variant of Form V. Under Anakin Skywalker's tutelage she studied alternate Form V disciplines and Form VI (Niman). Later she adopted a second, yellowish-green shoto and pursued Jar'Kai dual-blade fighting, partly to understand Asajj Ventress's favored form. [Powers and abilities > Lightsaber training; 7, 98]
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)
- The article calls her “unusually skilled for someone of her age” and says her technique used rapid switches and feints to exhaust an opponent. This is the article's assessment, not a separate feat. [Powers and abilities > Lightsaber training]
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)
- Concrete scaling statement: the article says that even early in the Clone Wars she could handle a trio of MagnaGuards, and by the end she was “going toe-to-toe with Dark Jedi such as Barriss Offee.” [Powers and abilities > Lightsaber training]
  Source: UNSOURCED on Wookieepedia (sentence found in "Ahsoka Tano/Legends" rev 15641706 but it has no inline citation in its paragraph; exact text match)
- The article further says she survived numerous one-on-one encounters with General Grievous and Asajj Ventress, describing survival as “a victory of sorts even by the most experienced Jedi.” This is the article's characterization/hype, not a claim that she defeated either opponent. [Powers and abilities > Lightsaber training]
  Source: UNSOURCED on Wookieepedia (sentence found in "Ahsoka Tano/Legends" rev 15641706 but it has no inline citation in its paragraph; exact text match)

SECTION: Named duels and direct combat

Duel on Tatooine — three MagnaGuards
- When Ahsoka separated from Anakin while he faced Count Dooku, she fought three MagnaGuards single-handedly. The article says she defeated them. [Biography > Clone Wars > Duel on Tatooine; 7]
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars film [per Wookieepedia "Ahsoka Tano/Legends" rev 15641706, ref 7; approximate match 0.70, verify]

Teth — Asajj Ventress
- The article says Ahsoka had a brief duel with Ventress during the rescue of Rotta. It does not call this a decisive victory; afterward Ahsoka destroyed battle droids and beheaded the spy droid 4A-7. [Biography > Clone Wars > Battle of Teth; 7]
  Source: The Clone Wars: Crash Course ; Star Wars: The Clone Wars film [per Wookieepedia "Ahsoka Tano/Legends" rev 15641706, ref 20,7; per-sentence approximate match (2/3 sentences matched, min 0.68), verify]

Mon Gazza — Asajj Ventress (second listed encounter)
- After her podracer crashed in Skeleton Straits, Ahsoka drew her lightsaber and engaged Ventress in a brief duel. Anakin rescued her by Force-crushing the data file as it landed in Ventress's hand; the article does not present this as an Ahsoka win. [Biography > Clone Wars > Mission to Mon Gazza; 20]
  Source: The Clone Wars: Crash Course [per Wookieepedia "Ahsoka Tano/Legends" rev 15641706, ref 20; per-sentence approximate match (2/3 sentences matched, min 0.64), verify]

Skytop Station — General Grievous
- Ahsoka saved Captain Rex from a killing blow, then engaged Grievous in a brief duel to lure him away from the clones. The article explicitly says she was one of the “extreme few” to face the cyborg and survive. Grievous proved too much for her to defeat, grabbed her by the neck, took her lightsaber, and said it would join his collection. When explosions distracted him, Ahsoka sliced off his right hand, used the Force to retrieve her lightsaber, and escaped through the vents. [Biography > Clone Wars > Mission to Skytop Station; 24]
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Duel of the Droids" [per Wookieepedia "Ahsoka Tano/Legends" rev 15641706, ref 24; per-sentence approximate match (4/4 sentences matched, min 0.83), verify]

Assault on the Tranquility — Asajj Ventress (with Luminara Unduli)
- Ahsoka initially faced Ventress and was tricked into being locked in Gunray's cell. Later, she joined Luminara Unduli when Ventress was gaining the upper hand. The two Jedi fought Ventress together, dodging her twin-lightsaber attacks and hurled rubble; Ahsoka rescued Luminara from attacks that could have killed her. The article does not state that Ahsoka defeated Ventress. [Biography > Clone Wars > Assault on the Tranquility; 25]
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)

Second Battle of Geonosis — Barriss Offee (brain-worm infection)
- Ahsoka and Barriss defeated two brain-worm-infected clones. After Barriss became infected, she attacked Ahsoka; during their duel Ahsoka ruptured the ship's coolant system and killed the worm emerging from Barriss rather than killing Barriss. [Biography > Clone Wars > Invasion on a supply ship; 46]
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)

Mission to Mortis — the Son / dark-side-infected Ahsoka versus Anakin and Obi-Wan
- The Son easily disarmed Ahsoka and Obi-Wan when they first confronted him. Later, after the Son infected Ahsoka with the dark side, she charged Anakin and unleashed a barrage of saber strikes. She activated her shoto and fought Anakin and Obi-Wan with both sabers; the article says they could not overcome her without hurting her. Ahsoka intercepted a dagger intended for Anakin, then the Son drained her life force, leaving her dead or near death. The Daughter's remaining life force, transferred through Anakin with the Father's help, resurrected her and purged the corruption. [Biography > Clone Wars > Mission to Mortis; 4]
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)

Wasskah — Trandoshan hunters
- Ahsoka briefly Force-choked and slammed a hunter who shot at her; the hunter threw her down and re-armed. She later killed the young hunter Dar in a fight and ultimately killed his father Garnac during the escape. The article's abilities section summarizes that she killed Dar and Garnac using hand-to-hand combat and Force powers. [Biography > Clone Wars > Second Battle of Felucia and Wasskah; 57, 58; Powers and abilities > Other abilities]
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Padawan Lost" ; Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Wookiee Hunt" [per Wookieepedia "Ahsoka Tano/Legends" rev 15641706, ref 58,57; per-sentence approximate match (2/4 sentences matched, min 0.75), verify]

Mandalore/Carlac — Pre Vizsla and Bo-Katan Kryze
- While unarmed, Ahsoka used the Force to throw a pole that impaled a Death Watch warrior, then attacked two more. Once R2-D2 returned her sabers, she cut her restraints and decapitated four Death Watch warriors in one spinning leap. Vizsla engaged her with the Darksaber: she blocked his attacks, was kicked outside, then attacked again and slashed his jetpack, making it explode. During the escape she deflected blaster bolts, used the Force to push a Nite Owl from the speeder, and briefly fought Bo-Katan hand-to-hand before pushing her off the speeder with the Force. [Biography > Clone Wars > Mandalore and Carlac; 66]
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)

Battle on Florrum — General Grievous
- After Grievous pursued Ahsoka and the younglings, she engaged him and kept him away from the younglings. After the speeder crashed, she attacked Grievous and delayed him long enough for the droids and younglings to board a ship; she then escaped. The article does not call this a victory over Grievous. [Biography > Clone Wars > Battle on Florrum]
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)

Duel and Capture — Barriss Offee
- The disguised attacker was Barriss Offee. In the abandoned building, Ahsoka fought her through an explosion; Barriss disarmed Ahsoka and kicked her through a wooden floor. Ahsoka was then stunned by Commander Wolffe and the clones. This outcome is distinct from the article's broader “toe-to-toe” characterization in the Lightsaber training section. [Biography > Clone Wars > Duel and Capture; 76]
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)

Other named combat
- On Taloraan, Ahsoka used agility and the Force to defeat Nardek in a trial by combat. [Biography > Clone Wars > Mission to Taloraan; 19]
  Source: The Clone Wars: The Wind Raiders of Taloraan [per Wookieepedia "Ahsoka Tano/Legends" rev 15641706, ref 19; approximate match 0.81, verify]
- On Kiros, she subdued Zygerrian commander Darts D'Nar while he wielded an electro-whip. [Biography > Clone Wars > Battle of Kiros; 63]
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)
- During the Citadel rescue, she ran Commander Osi Sobeck through the chest with her lightsaber, instantly killing him and saving Tarkin. [Biography > Clone Wars > Rescuing Even Piell; 54]
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)
- In the Archives, she defeated bounty hunter Cato Parasitti in a brief lightsaber duel, knocking her down. [Biography > Clone Wars > First Battle of Felucia and punishment; 37]
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Holocron Heist" [per Wookieepedia "Ahsoka Tano/Legends" rev 15641706, ref 37; approximate match 0.76, verify]
- Against Cad Bane while taking back the stolen holocron, Ahsoka deflected his blaster shot and injured his right arm, then flipped him to the ground. Bane kicked away her lightsaber and used a paralyzing electric shock to render her unconscious. [Biography > Clone Wars > Taking back the stolen holocron; 40]
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)
- On Naboo, Ahsoka confronted Bane at Roo-Roo Page's home. After Anakin joined the fight, Bane was outmatched and Ahsoka held her lightsaber to him; Bane was taken in binders. [Biography > Clone Wars > Taking back the stolen holocron; 41]
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Children of the Force" [per Wookieepedia "Ahsoka Tano/Legends" rev 15641706, ref 41; per-sentence approximate match (1/2 sentences matched, min 0.80), verify]
- The article's Other abilities section says Ahsoka could “easily overpower Cad Bane before dropping her guard and being incapacitated by the bounty hunter.” This is an article summary of the encounter, not a clean Ahsoka victory. [Powers and abilities > Other abilities; 40]
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Cargo of Doom" [per Wookieepedia "Ahsoka Tano/Legends" rev 15641706, ref 40; exact text match]

SECTION: Concrete Force feats

- Christophsis: Ahsoka sliced a droid in half with her lightsaber, then used the Force to bring down a wall so Anakin could pass through while droids beneath it were crushed; she detonated the generator, enabling artillery to finish the droid legions. [Biography > Clone Wars > Battle of Christophsis; 7]
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars film [per Wookieepedia "Ahsoka Tano/Legends" rev 15641706, ref 7; per-sentence approximate match (1/2 sentences matched, min 0.86), verify]
- Queel: she destroyed an artillery gun and a DSD1 dwarf spider droid with her lightsaber, then used the Force to throw an artillery shell at the remaining guns; Rex's blaster shot triggered an explosion that destroyed the artillery position. [Biography > Clone Wars > Battle of Queel; 20]
  Source: The Clone Wars: Crash Course [per Wookieepedia "Ahsoka Tano/Legends" rev 15641706, ref 20; approximate match 0.83, verify]
- Naboo/Blue Shadow Virus: she levitated a thermal detonator with the Force and dropped it on a bunker hatch, then drew battle droids away so Anakin could rescue Amidala and Jar Jar. While infected, she still helped Amidala clear droids from the lab. [Biography > Clone Wars > Mission to Naboo; 33, 34]
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Mystery of a Thousand Moons" [per Wookieepedia "Ahsoka Tano/Legends" rev 15641706, ref 33; per-sentence approximate match (1/2 sentences matched, min 0.65), verify]
- Rescuing Chairman Papanoida's daughters: she used the Force to levitate Chuchi out of sight and later used a mind trick on a guard; she and Chuchi dispatched B2 droids. [Biography > Clone Wars > Rescuing Chairman Papanoida's Daughters; 47]
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)
- Wasskah: she used the Force in combat against the Trandoshan hunters, survived being hunted, and led the escape of the remaining younglings. [Biography > Clone Wars > Second Battle of Felucia and Wasskah; 57, 58]
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)
- Battle of Kadavo: she helped rescue the enslaved Togruta by directing a cruiser to fly under the failing facility so the prisoners could escape onto it. [Biography > Clone Wars > Battle of Kadavo; 65]
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)
- Hondo Ohnaka's ship: she engaged Ohnaka to let younglings and Huyang escape, used the Force to shove most pirates back to their ship during decompression, and later helped rescue the pirates' prisoners. [Biography > Clone Wars > Captured by Ohnaka; 72]
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)
- Cato Neimoidia: when Anakin was knocked unconscious in his starfighter, she leapt onto it, pulled him out, and got him clear before the ship exploded. [Biography > Clone Wars > Battle on Cato Neimoidia; 75]
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)
- Mortis: after the group crashed, she repaired the shuttle. [Biography > Clone Wars > Mission to Mortis; 53]
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Weapons Factory" ; Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Ghosts of Mortis" [per Wookieepedia "Ahsoka Tano/Legends" rev 15641706, ref 45,53; approximate match 0.80, verify]

SECTION: Force powers and other abilities (cited statements)

- The article says Ahsoka had a strong connection to the Force, used Force Jump and acrobatics, and performed extensive telekinesis. It gives the large-wall pull-down on Christophsis as the example and says she was skilled in Force push, including using it to save Luminara Unduli. [Powers and abilities > Force powers; 25]
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Cloak of Darkness" [per Wookieepedia "Ahsoka Tano/Legends" rev 15641706, ref 25; per-sentence approximate match (1/2 sentences matched, min 0.64), verify]
- It says she had a strong Force sense: she sensed Plo Koon after the Malevolence destroyed his fleet and sensed children kidnapped by Cad Bane. [Powers and abilities > Force powers; 13, 41]
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Rising Malevolence" ; Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Children of the Force" [per Wookieepedia "Ahsoka Tano/Legends" rev 15641706, ref 13,41; approximate match 0.92, verify]
- It says she learned the Jedi mind trick and, with great effort, could create two duplicates that mirrored her movements and deflected blaster fire. [Powers and abilities > Force powers; 49, 82, 83]
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "The Academy" ; Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Sphere of Influence" ; Path of the Jedi on CartoonNetwork.com (backup link)(original site is defunct) [per Wookieepedia "Ahsoka Tano/Legends" rev 15641706, ref 49,82,83; approximate match 0.90, verify]
- The article attributes advanced visuospatial awareness/ultrasonic echolocation to her montrals, and says she used it to time the Christophsis wall drop so Anakin passed through a gap while droids were crushed. [Powers and abilities > Other abilities; 17]
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars novelization [per Wookieepedia "Ahsoka Tano/Legends" rev 15641706, ref 17; approximate match 0.61, verify]
- It calls her a talented pilot and says she showed potential as a war strategist by leading the attack that penetrated the Separatist blockade at Ryloth. It also says Anakin trained her to analyze enemy-ship technical scans quickly. [Powers and abilities > Other abilities; 35, 84]
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Storm Over Ryloth" ; Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Destroy Malevolence" (Decoded) [per Wookieepedia "Ahsoka Tano/Legends" rev 15641706, ref 35,84; approximate match 0.82, verify]
- It says she could overpower Cad Bane before being incapacitated when she dropped her guard; it also says she defeated a Mandalorian Secret Service group and subdued Prime Minister Almec while handcuffed, using a guard's shield. [Powers and abilities > Other abilities; 40, 49]
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Cargo of Doom" ; Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "The Academy" [per Wookieepedia "Ahsoka Tano/Legends" rev 15641706, ref 40,49; approximate match 0.72, verify]
- It says her mechanics knowledge helped save her and Barriss after the Geonosis droid factory collapse, and that she repaired the Mortis shuttle. [Powers and abilities > Other abilities; 45, 53]
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Weapons Factory" ; Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Ghosts of Mortis" [per Wookieepedia "Ahsoka Tano/Legends" rev 15641706, ref 45,53; approximate match 0.61, verify]
- It says she understood Shyriiwook, demonstrated by translating Chewbacca on Wasskah. [Powers and abilities > Other abilities; 57]
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Wookiee Hunt" [per Wookieepedia "Ahsoka Tano/Legends" rev 15641706, ref 57; approximate match 0.67, verify]

SECTION: Statements/opinions/hype — not feats

- Anakin, after Christophsis: “You're reckless, little one. You never would have made it as Obi-Wan's Padawan… but you might make it as mine.” [Battle of Christophsis; 7]
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars film [per Wookieepedia "Ahsoka Tano/Legends" rev 15641706, ref 7; exact text match]
- Anakin's assessment: “I admit, Ahsoka's a little rough around the edges, but with a great deal of training… and patience… she might amount to something.” [Powers and abilities > Lightsaber training; 7]
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars film [per Wookieepedia "Ahsoka Tano/Legends" rev 15641706, ref 7; exact text match]
- Anakin: “Because of Ahsoka's advanced abilities, I forgot how young she is.” [Powers and abilities > Force powers; 37]
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Holocron Heist" [per Wookieepedia "Ahsoka Tano/Legends" rev 15641706, ref 37; exact text match]
- Plo Koon/Anakin describe her as “fearless” and say, “No one has her kind of determination.” These are character opinions, not measurable feats. [Personality and traits; 58]
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Padawan Lost" [per Wookieepedia "Ahsoka Tano/Legends" rev 15641706, ref 58; exact text match]
- The article's opening summary says she engaged Ventress, Grievous, and Cad Bane several times and “always” survived without serious injury, and says she helped halt a plot masterminded by Darth Sidious. These are summary claims; the concrete encounter outcomes above are more specific and include losses/captures, so this wording should not be treated as a blanket win claim. [Lead]
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)
